block.waymod.way_block.description: Right-click: teleport to the given place. Shift+RMB: go back. The target is set with /way give or /way set.
block.waymod.craftable_spawner.descripti: The mob is set with /way spawner. Issued to operators and creative players only.
block.waymod.spawner_2000_pro.descriptio: Auto spawner: 3 rows, up to 150 mobs. Upgrade with cores: speed (down to 0.5 s), capacity, killer (loot ×5).
block.waymod.auto_hopper.description: Collects items across the whole chunk into an adjacent container. RMB with an item adds it to the filter, Shift+RMB removes, Shift+RMB empty-handed clears.
block.waymod.hopper_transmitter.descript: Sends items from an adjacent container to the linked one. Shift+RMB to select it, then /way link <coords>.
item.waymod.speed_core.description: RMB on a spawner: halves the spawn delay (min 0.5 s).
item.waymod.capacity_core.description: RMB on a spawner: +50 max alive mobs (up to 150).
item.waymod.killer_core.description: RMB on a spawner: spawned mobs are killed automatically, loot ×5.
command.waymod.not_way_block: There is no way block at this position.
command.waymod.bad_dimension: Unknown dimension: %s. Try overworld / nether / the_end or a dimension id like minecraft:overworld.
command.waymod.link_no_transmitter: First Shift+RMB a transmitter with an empty hand.
command.waymod.link_wrong_dim: The transmitter is in another dimension. Linking works within one dimension.
message.waymod.not_set: This way block has no target yet. Set it with /way set ...
message.waymod.hopper.filter_cleared: Filter cleared — the hopper takes everything.
message.waymod.hopper.filter_empty: Filter is empty — the hopper takes everything.
message.waymod.transmitter.unlinked: Transmitter is not linked. Shift+RMB it, then /way link <coords>.
